description: Look up one regulation by its Magist id and return structured research information: title, citation, jurisdiction, status, review dates, a plain-language summary, and the Controls that may satisfy it. Returns facts about what a regulation says, not a determination of how it applies to a specific product. Consult counsel for situation-specific questions.

id.description: Magist regulation id, e.g. "gdpr", "coppa", "ai-act". Use search_regulations to discover ids.

name: lookup_regulation
title: Look up a regulation
